offers.title: Collections Expert
offers.description:
Our users just got their bunq Credit Card and want to maintain their credit history. Most don’t want to fall behind, and they worry about what happens if they do. If they miss a payment, they need bunq to help them catch up, not hit them with shame or surprises. As our Collections Expert, you make sure collections stay fair, human, and effective. 🤝

Up for this? Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match! 💚
offers.requirements:
As our Collections Expert, you’ll own credit card collections end to end, from the first missed payment to a fair outcome for our users. Automation handles the first contact, and people step in from Day 30.

  • 📋 Make sure certified Support Adams offer standard payment plans correctly, and escalate non-standard cases to the Product Owner Lending

  • 💬 Set the tone for every outreach, so it stays empathetic, clear, and compliant, especially for vulnerable users

  • 🤖 Build AI-powered automation that scales our outreach, with a human in the loop where judgment matters

  • 📊 Track delinquency, recovery, and outreach results, and turn what you find into process improvements

  • ⚖️ Keep every step compliant and fair, working closely with Legal and Risk

  • 🔄 Run the handoff to our collections partner from Day 90, and make sure only cleared cases are referred

This challenge is perfect for you if ✨

  • You have deep expertise in collections strategy and portfolio risk, and you can decide when the picture is unclear

  • You stay calm and empathetic in stressful moments

  • You know debt collection and consumer credit regulations in depth, and you can apply them in gray areas

  • You analyze data and turn it into action

  • You lead across teams and balance competing priorities

  • You can oversee third parties and teams, and hold them to a high standard

  • You design and build AI-powered solutions to improve how your team works

offers.title: Head of Product
offers.description:
As Head of Product, your mission is to lead the product organization that builds what our users bank with every day, ensuring they get the safe, smart and effortless banking they expect.

Why this matters:
At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us.

Every team plays a unique role in making this mission a reality. The Product team does this by building and improving the products our users bank with, while keeping them safe and compliant.

As Head of Product, you contribute by setting product direction and leading the product leaders who deliver it, helping us grow as the bank of The Free.

Take ownership:
As Head of Product, you’ll take charge of key responsibilities that directly impact bunq’s growth and our users’ seamless experience:

  • Grow our users’ use of bunq’s products by leading product strategy and delivery for your area.

  • Keep growth and safety moving together, so that fraud, compliance and quality are built into the products rather than bolted on.

  • Build a strong, AI-first product organization by leading Product Owners and Team Leads, and redesigning how the function works around AI agents instead of adding headcount by default.

  • Be bunq’s product voice with the management board, regulators, auditors and partners.
offers.requirements:
• You’ve led a technical product organization and can get hands-on when needed. Size of organization isn’t the bar.

  • You have product leadership experience in a regulated financial services setting.

  • You understand payments and fraud, and you have data analysis skills and engineering depth.

  • You have experience working with regulators and across multiple markets.

  • You’re skilled at stakeholder management at management-board level.

  • You have AI fluency at the AI Architect level: you design AI-native systems, not only use AI tools.

offers.title: (Senior) Product Owner
offers.description:
At bunq, we're not just building a banking app; we're reshaping how people around the world experience financial freedom. As a (Senior) Product Owner at bunq, you are the driving force behind a core piece of our user's experience. Your mission is to own your product, understand our users (Eva) inside and out, and ship beautiful, effective features that make their lives easy.

We have several exciting and immediate openings within our Product sector. Submit your application, and our team will work with you to understand your unique skillset and interests, helping you find the perfect current opportunity that suits your career aspirations.

Take ownership

As a (Senior) Product Owner, you will own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for your domain, whatever that may be. You get it done.

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for your domain, relentlessly focused on solving user problems and creating massive value.

  • Lead the full product lifecycle, from identifying user needs and defining problems to collaborating with world-class engineers and designers to ship elegant and effective solutions.

  • Relentlessly use data, A/B testing, and user feedback to measure the impact of your work, ensuring every feature we ship moves us closer to our North Star.
offers.requirements:
• Proven experience in product management, with a track record of owning a product or significant features from concept to launch and beyond.

  • Experience in either Payments, AI, Business, Wealth, Stocks, Crypto, Savings, Credit, FinCrime & Security, International Expansion, Growth, UX, Retention, or Propositions is a major plus.

  • A deep, user-obsessed mindset, with a passion for turning complex problems into simple, elegant, and intuitive user experiences.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven skills. You are comfortable with data, know how to ask the right questions, and can use A/B testing and analytics to guide your product decisions.

  • A strong technical aptitude and the ability to have credible conversations with engineers. You don't need to be a coder, but you understand how software is built and can work effectively to find simple solutions to complex technical challenges.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English. You can articulate your vision, get buy-in, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, global team.

offers.title: Transaction Review Lead
offers.description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to truly make life easy for our user. Part of that is keeping her safe: stopping criminals while making sure clean users are never held up, flagged, or offboarded for nothing. To lead this, we’re looking for a Transaction Review Lead to join our team.

As Transaction Review Lead, you’ll own bunq’s line against money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions evasion, across both Transaction Filtering Review and Transaction Monitoring Review. You’ll bring them together into one team, with 5 direct reports.

Take Ownership:

  • Simplifying from user’s Perspective: Redesign every Transaction Review process starting from what’s best for the user, as part of our zero-based Future of FinCrime redesign.

  • AI Where It Counts: Establish the real volumes first, then use AI and in-house models only where they make things faster or better for Eva, not automation for its own sake.

  • Risk Ownership: Own the quarterly risk assessment across both domains and close CAP items before they turn into compliance breaches.

  • One Team, One Rhythm: Unite TFR and TMR behind the same KPIs (CSAT, UE, Total Handle Time, Compliance breaches) with a clear weekly cadence, owners, and fast escalation of blockers.

  • Decisions That Hold Up: Make sure the rationale behind every investigation decision is documented to a standard that would survive a regulator’s review.

  • Coaching & Accountability: Give your team direct, constructive feedback and hold everyone accountable for delivering.
offers.requirements:
• You lead independently across multiple compliance domains, making quality, redesign, and escalation calls without waiting for supervision.

  • You have strong regulatory and compliance judgment at scale in TF/sanctions and transaction monitoring, where a wrong call has real regulatory consequences.

  • You spot risks early and close them before they become problems, and you can show us when you did.

  • You have an AI-native, process-simplification mindset: you rethink the process from Eva’s side first and go AI-led only when it clears a real business case.

  • Bonus: AML/sanctions plus transaction monitoring experience, or experience leading a team through a consolidation or restructure.

  • You’re an excellent communicator and speak English fluently.

offers.title: Partnership Ops Intern
offers.description:
Our users often meets bunq for the first time through one of our partners, and they're usually already trying to solve a problem we can fix. Whether they're picking up a new IBAN, starting a company, or moving abroad, they're deciding right now. If the booth is unstaffed, the referral link is broken, or the campaign ships a week late, we will loose them. As our Partnerships Ops Intern, you make sure that never happens, by turning signed partners into live campaigns and events that bring in new users.

Up for this? Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match! 🚀

Take ownership

As our Partnerships Ops Intern, you’ll contribute to the Partnerships team by running the operational side of partner campaigns and on-site events, so every touchpoint with our users works the moment she arrives.

  • Run the operational plan for partner campaigns and on-site events end to end, from booth setup to teardown, staffing, materials, and day-of troubleshooting 🎪

  • Qualify inbound partners and decide which bunq proposition fits their audience best: Savings, Payments, or tricount 🎯

  • Write clear first-touch outreach, schedule intro calls, and follow up on contracts and renewals 📩

  • Align the teams a launch depends on (Copy, Legal, Engineering, Design, and external vendors) and make sure nothing slips 🤝

  • Run the launch checklist and QA gate before every campaign goes live: working deep links, attribution firing, one clear benefit per asset ✅

  • Read the weekly cost-per-user numbers, spot partners that drift off benchmark, and flag them before they burn another cycle 📊
offers.requirements:
• You’ve organized events or on-site activations before, and you stay calm when something breaks mid-morning 🎪

  • You write clear, direct outreach and you’re comfortable getting on a call with a partner

  • You run checklists and trackers without dropping steps, and you spot the small detail that blocks a launch

  • You understand the basics of unit-economics reporting, and you can read a dashboard and act on what it tells you

  • You use AI to work smarter and you’re keen to build simple automations that take the repetitive work off your plate
